Reinforcement and punishment

Placeholder paragraph for the test fixture. In operant conditioning a behavior is shaped by what follows it. Positive reinforcement adds something pleasant and negative reinforcement removes something unpleasant; both make the behavior more likely. Positive punishment adds something unpleasant and negative punishment removes something pleasant; both make it less likely. Partial schedules of reinforcement, especially variable-ratio schedules, produce behavior that is hard to extinguish.
